deals.comment: Sublime Artist Agency Co., Ltd. acquired 94% stake in Nylon Korea Media Co., Ltd. from Krispy Studio Corporation and others for approximately KRW 140 million on June 1, 2019. Sublime Artist Agency Co., Ltd. acquired 0.103 million shares from Krispy Studio Corporation for KRW 98.5 million and 0.044 million shares from others for KRW 42 million. Post completion, Krispy Studio Corporation will hold no stake in Nylon Korea Media Co., Ltd.

Playlist Corporation intends to acquire 3.76% minority stake in Sublime Artist Agency Inc. for approximately KRW 300 million on September 9, 2019. Under the term, Playlist Corporation will acquire 172 shares of Sublime Artist Agency. As of December 31, 2018, Sublime Artist Agency reported total assets of KRW 280 million, total debt of KRW 419 million and net loss of KRW 211 million. The transaction was resolved by the board of directors on September 9, 2019. The transaction is expected to close on September 20, 2019.

An unknown buyer agreed to acquire 2.35% stake in Sublime Artist Agency Inc. from Playlist Corporation for approximately KRW 1 billion on June 20, 2022. The number of shares of Sublime Artist are 172 that will sell in this transaction. The board resolution date is June 20, 2022. The expected completion date is June 30, 2022.

HLL JoongAng Co., Ltd. agreed to acquire 42% stake in Sublime Co., Ltd for approximately KRW 19,319 million on June 28, 2022. Sublime generated the Total assets of KRW 11,714 million, Total Debt of KRW 2,236 million, Total equity of KRW 9,478 million and Net Income of KRW 680 million for the year 2021. Acquisition is expected to close on July 1, 2022.

HLL JoongAng Co., Ltd. agreed to acquire additional 6.6% in Sublime Artist Agency Inc. for KRW 4 billion on July 20, 2022. Sublime generated the Total assets of KRW 11,714 million, Total Debt of KRW 2,236 million, Total equity of KRW 9,478 million and Net Income of KRW 680 million for the year 2021.
